text:
Emma: quick sync — console observability handoff. Need to lock owners for: dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestone for next sprint. Who can own each by EOD?
Alice: I'll take dashboards (templates + KB). Will pair with Ben for perf panels. ETA Wed.
Ben: ack — drafting the dash list this afternoon, will call out required metrics. pinging Dan for metric ownership.
Dan: can own metric mapping for runtime/latency panels. small dependency: eng-sre needs to confirm histogram retention config.
Fiona: tracing hooks PR is ready for review: https://git.redwood/rt/trace-hooks/pull/421 — added sampling toggle and tests. Need a decision on default sampling.
Carlos: can review the trace PR tomorrow AM. Q: should default sampling be 1% or 5%? 5% gives better tail signal but costs more storage.
Emma: start with 1% default, but PR should include an opt-in param for 5% and a short note in the migration doc.
Ben: noted. Dan — retention question: do we standardize on 30d for dashboards and 90d for audit views? or keep everything 90d for now?
Dan: 30d is fine for realtime dashboards (latency/errors). 90d for audit/history views only. I'll file a ticket to split retention tiers and link it here.
Oliver: I’ll take error-analysis views (stack traces + user-flow joins). I need SSO access to the logs index to build queries — @eng-sre can you grant access?
eng-sre: can grant. infra-bot will add Oliver + Fiona to logs-access group and post confirmation.
infra-bot: granted logs-access to Oliver and Fiona. :white_check_mark:
Carlos: flagged a schema change in spans; I added a migration plan section in the PR. We should coordinate rollout order to avoid ingestion issues.
Fiona: adding a canary plan too. Can we run a small-scale canary on Dedicated infra next Tue? @eng-sre please advise on capacity/slot.
eng-sre: we have a canary slot Tue 10:00-12:00 UTC; please add runbook steps to the PR and tag us.
Emma: owners summary: - Dashboards: Alice + Ben - Metrics/retention: Dan - Tracing hooks + schema: Carlos + Fiona - Error-analysis views: Oliver
Action items: owners to post a short checklist in the sprint ticket by EOD, link PRs, include reviewers, and note any SRE runbook steps. If blockers show up, reply in this thread.
Alice: will post checklist + dash templates in the ticket in ~2h.
Ben: doing outreach to reviewers now. :cat:
Carlos: will open follow-up migration RFC this afternoon.
Emma: thanks — if everyone can confirm in-thread when checklists/PR links are up, I’ll mark owners locked for sprint planning.
Alice: confirmed I'll post within 2 hours.
Ben: confirmed dash list posted (ticket #OBS-1789).
Dan: retention ticket #OBS-1790 created, linking here.
Fiona: PI for canary added to the PR.
Emma: perfect — closing the loop. We'll revisit if any blockers remain before planning.
